label: v0.1.19 Industry Performance Benchmark. Post-route static timing from nextpnr. Not a programmed board. Power is not measured.
power: NOT MEASURED — needs a programmed board. No board power measurement was taken.
formula: values/s = (element_frames / cycles) * fmax_MHz * 1e6; element_frames and cycles are from the design's committed simulation report on the named stream; fmax_MHz is the minimum achieved clock in that seed's nextpnr report

fit.note: 12F, 25F and 85F use one seed. nextpnr --pack-only runs first. If packing fails, routing is not run and the failure text is the record. If packing succeeds, one full place-and-route (router2, --timing-allow-fail, no --tmg-ripup) decides whether it fits. 45F timing is five seeds and is not pack-only.

flow.note: Achieved Fmax is the minimum clock in the nextpnr report. The 12 MHz flag is the target, not the result. --timing-allow-fail keeps a routed design that misses that target.

design_set: Every RTL encoder, decoder and loop module, at the configuration earlier specs compare (W=2 and W=4 where the width changes the netlist; encoders and loops at L=8). Other (W, L) values of the same module are not re-placed.

bit_exact.method: Re-simulate each RTL check against the committed golden vectors (Icarus Verilog).
